resources.string: Shows two barcodes you can set by tapping
Only letters, numbers and basic symbols are supported

To use this app:

1. Long-press your home screen
2. Choose Widgets
3. Add the Barcode Widget
4. Tap the top or bottom half, type a code and press Enter

The widget shows your text as a scannable Code 128 barcode. No settings, no permissions, nothing else.
